# Fire Harmony pipeline configuration (all paths outside the repo)
paths:
  raw: ~/nasa_work/data/raw
  work: ~/nasa_work/data/work          # silver / gold layers (large, local only)
  products: ~/nasa_work/data/products  # files published to the app
  duckdb_temp: ~/nasa_work/data/tmp_duckdb

duckdb:
  memory_limit: 2GB                     # machine has 7 GB with ~3 GB used by other apps; DuckDB spills to disk beyond this
  threads: 4
  max_temp_size: 5GB                    # spill files are capped, so one query can never fill the disk

disk:                                   # WSL's virtual disk lives on Windows C:, so every GB written here uses C:
  watch: /mnt/c
  min_free_gb: 10                       # pipeline commands refuse to start below this

years: [2000, 2026]

h3_levels: [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]           # 8 (~0.74 km2) is only used for the static-source mask
analysis_level: 5                       # ~253 km2 hexagons

confidence:
  modis_low_below: 30                   # MODIS percent < 30 -> low
  modis_high_from: 80                   # MODIS percent >= 80 -> high

license: cc-by-4.0

tags: [wildfire, remote-sensing, nasa, modis, viirs, firms, h3]

# Fire Harmony data (version 1.0)

One consistent record of vegetation fire hotspots for the whole world, November 2000 to 2026-11, on the NOAA-20 VIIRS
scale: MODIS (Terra, Aqua) and VIIRS (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) hotspots from NASA FIRMS, harmonized so that the
switch of satellites leaves no jump. Built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Files (in `v1.0/`): `area_monthly.parquet` (world, continents, countries and states per month), `map_l3` and
`map_l4` (hexagon maps per month), `cell_l3`, `cell_l4` and `l5/` (hexagon series), `clim_*` (normal seasons),
`drivers*.parquet`, `outlook.parquet`, `haze.parquet`, and `meta.json` / `dashboard.json` / `areas.json` / `haze.json`.

Units: hotspots per month on the NOAA-20 VIIRS scale. Modelled months (before 2012) come with 90% ranges (meta.json).

`hotspots/`: every NASA FIRMS hotspot, 640,601,590 of them, one file per H3 level 1 region (`l1=<hex>.parquet`, listed in
